findings: HB81 plan section separates drive shaft bearings from the roller-pinion and chain drive.
HB82/83 show paired rim installation and central chain-case clearance; perspective views are not metric controls.
HB119 labels outer M1407, M1402, M1477 and M1411; inner locking plate placement remains inferred.
Source M1406/M1977 rivet allocation conflicts with the initial M1977/M1978 hull panel seam mapping.
SNL215 roller-pinion shaft BOM has no nuts; do not assume M1411 belongs to it.
HB125 labeled driving-wheel section confirms stepped outer bearing, backing M1552 plate and key at the outer bearing; M1410 denotes the oil plug, not another shaft.

Original HB237 (MarkVIII119) prints two M1411 locking plates with two nuts in its one-inner/one-outer-bearing drive-wheel subset; supports two per drive shaft, despite the inconsistent Number per machine heading.
HB16 distinguishes the round roller-pinion oil access from the hex-nut drive-wheel end. No evidence for transferring M1411 to the pinion shaft.
HB129 and SNL7 label external M1975/M1976 plates but do not resolve inner M1977/M1978 extents.
HB131 shows three gasoline tanks and roof leaves M1785/M1786; this installation photograph does not identify the inner bearing receiver.

Direct inspection of the original SNL189 scan confirms adjacent rows: six 3/4 x 2 1/2 rivets at each M1978/M1546 pinion bearing and six 3/4 x 2 5/8 at each M1977/M1406 drive bearing (12 vehicle each). This supports correcting the initial inner fore/aft plate assignments, not merely shifting one seam.
